events.instrument: Ley N° 21.773, Modifica la Carta Fundamental en materia de derecho de sufragio de personas extranjeras (D.O. 7-oct-2025)
events.article: Constitución Art. 14 inciso primero; Art. 15 inciso segundo; disposición transitoria quincuagésima cuarta
events.what_changed: Art. 14 previously let foreigners resident ('avecindados') in Chile for more than five years vote. It now requires more than ten uninterrupted years, counted only from the grant of a permanent residence permit, with no absences of more than 90 days in any 12-month period. The 54th transitory provision brings this into force 'desde el año 2026', after the 2025 elections. The vote stays conditioned on long permanent residence, not on lawful presence, so under the MRD convention the answer is unchanged, but the condition is much stricter.
events.passage: «Artículo 14.- Los extranjeros avecindados en Chile por más de diez años ininterrumpidos, y que cumplan con los requisitos señalados en el inciso primero del artículo 13, podrán ejercer el derecho de sufragio en los casos y formas que determine la ley. Para estos efectos, los extranjeros sólo se considerarán avecindados a partir del momento en que obtengan un permiso de residencia definitiva.» ... «comenzarán a regir desde el año 2026»

events.instrument: Ley N° 21.779, modifica la Ley N° 18.700 para sancionar el incumplimiento de la obligación de sufragar
events.what_changed: Introduces fines for 'ciudadanos' who do not vote. This satisfies the precondition in the 54th transitory provision of Ley 21.773. Foreigners entitled to vote are not fined (per BCN Ley Fácil). It does not change who may vote.
events.passage: "Artículo 139 bis.- El ciudadano que no sufrague en las elecciones será sancionado con una multa a beneficio municipal de 0,5 a 1,5 unidades tributarias mensuales.

answers.implementation_then_now: The answer is the lowest option on both dates, so implementation is 'Does Not Apply'. For the record, Servel data show the conditional right is applied in practice: foreigners are registered automatically. There were 676,028 foreign electors for the December 2023 plebiscite and more than 786,000 for the October 2024 municipal and regional elections (CNN Chile, citing Servel). Media reports cite about 886,000 for the 2025 presidential and parliamentary elections. The 10-year rule applies from 2026, so its effect on the voter roll could not be seen by 1 January 2026.

answers.sourcing_note: The amendment is dated from the text of Ley 21.773 as reproduced by ImmiChile and confirmed by BCN's official Ley Fácil guide ('Hasta las elecciones ... de 2025, rige la exigencia de llevar cinco años avecindado ... A partir de 2026, se amplía ... a 10 años'). LeyChile rendered only the Constitution's index, not the article text or its versions, and the Diario Oficial PDF could not be parsed. The 2023 text (five years) was rebuilt from this amending act. The DFL 2 and Ley 20.568 articles cited by the starting answer were not opened.

answers.starting_answer_concern: Art. 14 lets resident foreigners vote in every popular election, including presidential, parliamentary and plebiscites, not only local ones. The 'No' seems to follow the MRD convention (as in the Argentina and Colombia examples) that a right conditioned on long residence is not one that lawful presence creates. If that convention were dropped, Chile would be 'Right to vote in national elections' on both dates, and the change would be 'right protections both in 2023 and 2026 but they are not the same' (five years before, ten years of permanent residence after).
answers.notes: Ley 21.773 was published on 2025-10-07. It applies 'desde el año 2026', read here as from 1 January 2026, so the ten-year rule is in force on 1 January 2026. Its precondition, a law on fines for non-voting, was met by Ley 21.779 (D.O. 2025-10-23). The answer is kept at 'No' for consistency with the starting answer, but the substantive conditional right was materially narrowed in the window. No court ruling on this point was relied on.

provisions.instrument: Ley N° 18.695, Orgánica Constitucional de Municipalidades

answers.implementation_then_now: No protection on either date, so 'Does Not Apply'. Elective office stays reserved to citizens: a concejal must be 'ciudadano con derecho a voto' (BCN Ley Fácil). Foreigners can run only after naturalisation, and then only after five years as nationals. No practice shift applies.
answers.sourcing_note: Ley 21.773 (2025) replaced only the first paragraph of Art. 14 (foreigners' vote) and amended Art. 15. Its text, as read, does not touch citizenship or eligibility rules. LeyChile did not render the article text of the Constitution or of Ley 18.695 Art. 73. The eligibility requirement was read in BCN's official Ley Fácil guide.
